commandOrSteps: Set VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api, VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://e2e.test, and VITE_WS_URL=wss://e2e.test; start local Vite at http://127.0.0.1:4189; run node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config=playwright.u01-03-local-temp.config.mjs. The temporary one-worker Desktop Chrome config selected tests/e2e/auth-session.spec.ts; Playwright page.route fixtures handled Auth API requests. The temporary config was removed and Vite was stopped after the run. Also run both TypeScript no-emit projects, focused ESLint, and Prettier formatting.
environment: Windows 11; Node v24.19.0; @playwright/test 1.63.0; Vite 6.4.3; Chromium 153.0.8010.12; local Vite API mode at http://127.0.0.1:4189; e2e.test Auth API calls use Playwright route fixtures; backend and staging disconnected.
expected: Email and phone registration submit the contract-shaped request with an idempotency key, receive a 202 registration challenge, and display only the server-provided masked destination on the OTP page. Registration must not create an authenticated session or call verifyMfa before the API/security owner resolves guest verification semantics.
actual: The combined auth-session browser suite passed 12/12; the two new registration challenge cases passed 2/2. Email and phone each submitted POST /auth/register with {fullName, channel, contact, password, acceptedTerms:true} and a UUID-shaped Idempotency-Key. The local route fixture returned HTTP 202 with challengeId, channel, maskedDestination, and expiresAt; the browser reached /w/auth/otp, showed the server-provided masked destination and six OTP inputs, and did not show auth-sign-out. The Playwright guard observed 0 POST /auth/mfa/verify calls. Both TypeScript no-emit projects, focused ESLint and Prettier passed. OpenAPI gate passed (15 contracts/154 operations); dependency-cruiser passed (863 modules/4,679 dependencies, 0 violations); architecture inventory passed (129 pages/427 routes/149 components/32 services/28 mocks); lint budget passed (0 errors/0 warnings); EOL check passed (3,222 paths, 0 missing line terminators); and git diff --check passed. check-tracking exited 1 with 74 source-ledger errors: 32 missing catalogued hashes, 5 paths absent from cataloguedSourceHead, 36 current source mismatches, and 1 historical change missing beforeHash; exact application path inventory remains 916/916. All e2e.test Auth requests were intercepted by Playwright; no backend call was made.
notes: This is local frontend evidence against contract-shaped Playwright fixtures. It establishes challenge issuance and masked rendering only. It does not validate OTP verification, API owner security semantics, email/SMS delivery, backend or staging behavior, production readiness, or user acceptance. Guest verifyMfa remains blocked on an explicit API/security owner decision about sessionCookie versus pre-auth credentials.
